description: This file defines the ContextHelper class, which provides a set of convenience methods for interacting with ScriptContext objects within the OFBiz framework, especially in scripting environments. It includes methods for managing bindings, environment variables, request/response objects, and other contextual data relevant to scripting execution.

classes.name: ContextHelper
classes.description: A utility class for simplifying interactions with ScriptContext in scripting scenarios within OFBiz, providing access to environment, request, response, and other contextual data.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the scripting engine's bindings.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Expands environment variables within a string using the current bindings.

methods.name: getBindings
methods.description: Returns the current script engine bindings.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator object from the script context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher object from the script context.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment using key syntax support.

methods.name: getErrorMessages
methods.description: Returns a list of error messages stored in the environment.

methods.name: getEnvEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the environment entries.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale object from the context.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Returns the VisualTheme object from the context.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the context parameters.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns all parameters stored in the context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletRequest object from the context.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletResponse object from the context.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves a result value from the context results.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Returns the map of results stored in the context.

methods.name: getScriptName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently executing script.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves the Security object from the context.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the TimeZone object from the context.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the GenericValue representing the logged-in user.

methods.name: isEvent
methods.description: Checks if the script is an event type.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if the script is a service type.

methods.name: putAllEnv
methods.description: Inserts multiple key-value pairs into the environment.

methods.name: putParameter
methods.description: Stores a parameter in the context parameters.

methods.name: putResult
methods.description: Stores a result value in the context results.

methods.name: putResults
methods.description: Puts multiple results into the context results map.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes a binding from the script context.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment using key syntax support.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Stores the user login information in the environment under a specified name.
